description: ⊆ and ⊈ compare two tag sets, and ∅ takes its kind from the other side of =. Only the first alternative of text holds, since V ⊈ tags($x) fails where $x carries V (engine §10).
grammar:
%rule text p q r | p s r
%rule p $x(W) %conditions V ⊆ tags($x)
%rule q $x(W) %conditions ~v ⊈ tags($x)
%rule r $x(W) %conditions tags($x) ∖ (V ∪ W) = ∅, tags($x) ∩ ~v = ∅
%rule s $x(W) %conditions V ⊈ tags($x)
